mapper.select: select count(*) from blog_user where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0
select count(*) from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and create_time >= #{date} and create_time < date_add(#{date}, interval 1 day)

select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as count from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by date(create_time) order by date(create_time)

select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as count from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by date(create_time) order by date(create_time)

select up.avatar, up.nickname, c.content, c.target_type, case when c.target_type = 1 then ifnull(a.article_title, '') when c.target_type = 3 then ifnull(left(t.content, 20), '') else '' end as target_name, c.create_time as created_at from blog_comment c left join blog_user_profile up on c.user_id = up.user_id and up.deleted_at = 0 left join blog_article a on c.target_type = 1 and c.target_id = a.id and a.deleted_at = 0 left join blog_talk t on c.target_type = 3 and c.target_id = t.id and t.deleted_at = 0 where c.deleted_at = 0 and c.review = 0 order by c.create_time desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 1
select count(*) from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 1
select count(*) from blog_category where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_tag where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_friend_link where deleted_at = 0
select article_title as name, view_count from blog_article where deleted_at = 0 and status = 1 order by view_count desc limit #{limit}

select c.category_name as name, count(a.id) as value from blog_category c inner join blog_article a on c.id = a.category_id and a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 where c.deleted_at = 0 group by c.id, c.category_name order by value desc
select target_type, count(*) as value from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 group by target_type
select count(*) from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and create_time >= #{date} and create_time < date_add(#{date}, interval 1 day)
select count(*) from blog_like_record where status = 1 and date(create_time) = #{date}

select t.tag_name as name, count(bat.article_id) as value from blog_tag t inner join blog_article_tag bat on t.id = bat.tag_id and bat.deleted_at = 0 inner join blog_article a on bat.article_id = a.id and a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 where t.deleted_at = 0 group by t.id, t.tag_name order by value desc limit #{limit}
